blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No ticket won the jackpots in the Ultra Lotto 6/58, Super Lotto 6/49 and Lotto 6/42 draws on Tuesday, Sept. 15, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination was 53-49-56-01-18-50 for a jackpot of ₱299.25 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. For Super Lotto 6/49, the winning combination was 23-42-33-15-14-30, with a jackpot of ₱25.17 million. PCSO said there was no jackpot winner. The Lotto 6/42 combination was 32-02-05-13-06-27 for a jackpot of ₱41.87 million. No ticket won the top prize. READ: Lotto Results Today – September 15, 2026 Minor games Draw schedule […]...
